scripts.build:all: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @unificard/contracts && npm run typecheck -w unificard-backend && (npm run typecheck -w unificard-frontend || cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit)
scripts.validate:contracts: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @unificard/contracts
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:contracts && npm run typecheck
